In this video we cover:
CEAT vs Apollo Tyres: Q1 FY26 Performance Breakdown
We will look into the Q1 FY26 results of India’s two major tyre companies, CEAT and Apollo Tyres. Both reported revenue growth, but margins came under pressure due to rising raw material costs and international challenges. Apollo’s premiumisation strategy and strong Indian business helped it protect profitability better than CEAT, while CEAT saw higher volume growth but at the cost of lower margins. We will also talk about their capex plans, supply chain risks, and growing competition in the tyre industry.
